query: Terrion Arnold Detroit Lions Commissioner's Exempt List released waived NFL transaction status July 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the bottom line on **Terrion Arnold's NFL transaction status as of mid-July 2026**:

**Current status: Cleared waivers → unrestricted free agent. NOT signed. NOT on the Commissioner's Exempt List (yet).**

Key findings:
- The **Detroit Lions waived/released Arnold in late June 2026**, hours after a Florida judge set his bond at **$1 million**. He was the Lions' 2024 first-round pick (No. 24, Alabama).
- He faces **eight felony counts** (four armed robbery, four kidnapping) from an alleged February 2026 incident; arrested June 24, 2026.
- The release hit the NFL transactions report with a **waiver claim deadline of Monday, July 6, 2026, 4:00 p.m. ET**. He **cleared waivers** (no team wanted the remaining ~2 years of his rookie deal).
- **Four teams reportedly interested** per agent Nicole Lynn: **Texans** (worked him out), **Colts**, **Jets**, **Seahawks**. No contract offered yet; Lynn expects a signing within ~45 days.
- **Commissioner's Exempt List**: Not applied yet — placement generally follows signing. Albert Breer (SI, July 13) reported the situation is "lined right up" for the Exempt List, on which Arnold would keep his guaranteed pay but be sidelined indefinitely at Goodell's discretion.

**Caveat:** Latest confirmed reporting is July 10–13, 2026. As of the July 17 question date, there's no confirmation he has signed or been formally placed on the Exempt List — the situation is actively evolving.
